Extended the scrubber to cover the new tag fields and added a schema-diff check that flags unscrubbed fields whenever the telemetry schema grows.

The quarantine metrics also went out under three different name prefixes during the migration and the dashboards are stitching them with regex glue. Consolidate on the current prefix and backfill the panels.
Consolidated the metrics on the current prefix, backfilled the panels, and the regex stitching is gone from all three dashboards.

Parser version pinning needs attention too: the re-drive path can run a newer parser than the one that held the batch, and last week that turned two legitimate holds into confusing double rejections with different codes.
Pinned re-drive to record the parser version at hold time and annotate any code change between hold and re-drive; the double-rejection confusion is labeled in the notification now.
Capacity call closed this one out, note it: the quarantine lane gets 2 GiB per node, carved from the spool volume, and the sizing sheet should stop showing the placeholder.
Noted in the sizing sheet with the placeholder removed; the carve-out is in the volume plan with the capacity call linked.
Last one: rehearse the overflow path before the sizing lands, with a synthetic tenant flooding malformed batches, so we see the park-oldest behaviour on a board instead of trusting the code comment.
Rehearsed with a synthetic flood tenant; park-oldest behaved as documented and the board panels captured the whole sequence for the review.
